prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Mulher marinha, the benevolent goat-footed sea woman of Portuguese and Azorean tradition emerging from the water.
ANATOMY: ONE adult WOMAN with ONE head, TWO natural eyes, TWO human arms, upper torso fully clothed in opaque high-neck long-sleeved dark sea-green woven blouse. From WAIST DOWN her body is fully covered in dark silver-green SCALES, with TWO separate human-proportioned LEGS, small FINS running along OUTER SIDES of BOTH LEGS, each leg ends in a clearly visible split GOAT HOOF. NO fish tail, no horns, no wings, no extra limbs. Scales completely cover hips and thighs [mulher-marinha-c01,mulher-marinha-c02].
MOMENT: Step forcefully out of foaming sea onto a black rock toward viewer, one goat hoof plants in foreground and second hoof lifts behind with water streaming from finned calf; one hand braces rock and other reaches forward in solemn greeting. Face intent and compassionate, wet hair swept backward by real sea wind.
POWER: leaves water and brings joy, fertility and fortune, no destructive power or visible magic; real surf breaks against legs only [mulher-marinha-c03].
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low shore-rock angle but FULL figure within square so TWO scaled legs, TWO fins and TWO goat hooves unmistakable; head and upper body large enough to read, normal human scale.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one golden sunset behind surf gives amber rim on scales, hooves and opaque cloth, deep walnut basalt shadows, ordinary sea spray.
SURFACE: wet silver-green scales, ridged goat hooves, translucent thin leg fins, opaque soaked blouse, rough black basalt.
SETTING: editorial Azorean rocky sea shore, open Atlantic secondary [mulher-marinha-c03].
MOOD: awe-inspiring benevolent sea hybrid, active powerful emergence, never evil, cute mermaid, erotic model, ordinary woman or fish-tailed mermaid.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, inscriptions, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no design borrowed from any film, game, anime or comic; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons. Premium painterly brushwork, dark warm walnut and antique gold palette, square composition.
